title: Impossible to find a flat in London

key_point: Agents require income over 30x monthly rent (rent under 40% gross); savings may count; upfront rent used as workaround; practice varies.

title: Renting in London
key_point: Minimise rent plus commute cost; flatshares via SpareRoom; OpenRent to avoid fees; negotiate below asking in slow periods.

title: Moving to England
key_point: Newcomers without UK bank/credit history struggle; asked for 6 months rent upfront; found pet-friendly let outside London.

title: Where to live in London
key_point: 46 replies; commute to London Bridge/Liverpool St dominates, then rent, green space, area character; SE London suggested.

title: Moving to London - housing guidance
key_point: Seattle relocator wants Zone 2, under 30 min commute, GBP 2k; council tax, energy, fares push true cost higher.

title: Help with areas
key_point: Single renter, GBP 2k, safe area with transport; replies first ask workplace and direct lines before suggesting areas.

title: Good Jobs, Good Tenants? Field Evidence of Racial and Gender Discrimination in the UK's Housing Market

key_point: London correspondence test: White British 51% response vs Indian 39%; job info raises all, gap persists; taste-based discrimination.

key_point: 62 UK 18-35s: rental choices constrained by precarity and local markets; reliance on family support; delayed family formation.

title: London rents Q2 2026

key_point: 2,000+ London tenants: affordability overriding; outdoor space 58%, commute 51%, broadband 48%, workspace 44%; 44% open to moving out.

key_point: 19.9% of London lets agreed above asking vs 12% nationally; London tenants paid 100.9% of asking on average.

key_point: Survey of 2,548 renters: affordability 26% top priority, location/transport 10%, size 10%, pet-friendly 9%.
